# New renderings chosen in odyssey-114 (23.288–372)

| Greek | `l` | `i` | avoided on purpose |
|---|---|---|---|
| ψολόεις κεραυνός (23.330, ψολόεντι κεραυνῷ; ψολόεις from ψόλος "soot") | "smoky thunderbolt" | "smoky thunderbolt" | "sooty", "murky", "dark" (loses the smoke); kept apart from ἀργῆτι κεραυνῷ "bright thunderbolt" |
| πολυκηδής (23.351, πολυκηδέα νόστον; πολύ + κῆδος "sorrow, care") | "many-sorrowed" | "so full of sorrows" | "much-troubled", "painful", "grievous" (reserved for λυγρός) |
| πολυκλήϊς νηῦς (23.324, νηῒ πολυκλήϊδι; κληΐς a fitting of the ship’s rowing, exact sense uncertain) | "a many-thwarted ship" | "his many-thwarted ship" (+ note: thwarts, benches or oar-fastenings uncertain) | "well-benched" (reserved for ἐΰσσελμος), "many-oared", "many-locked" |
| κακαὶ κῆρες (23.332, κακὰς ὑπὸ κῆρας ἄλυξεν; plural of κήρ "death-fate", follows ἔκφυγε κῆρα) | "evil death-fates" | "the evil fates of death" | "evil dooms", "black fates", "evil deaths" |
| Σειρῆνες ἁδιναί (23.326, Σειρήνων ἁδινάων) | "the thronging Sirens" | "the thronging Sirens" (+ note: sense of ἁδινός for the Sirens uncertain) | "clear-voiced", "shrill", "sweet" (picks a guess); follows μῆλ’ ἁδινά "thronging sheep" and ἁδινὸν κῆρ "thronging heart" |
| φιλότης ἐρατεινή (23.300, φιλότητος … ἐρατεινῆς) | "lovely love" | "lovely love" | "sweet love", "delightful love-making", "love’s delights"; ἐρατεινός "lovely" as in the table |
| ἔντεα ἀρήϊα (23.368) | "warlike gear" | "warlike gear" | "armour" (reserved for τεύχεα), "weapons", "arms of war"; ἀρήιος "warlike" as in the table |
